Postdoc: empirical methods for early-modern games

Federico Pianzola @fpianz #1 2023-10-04 11:23 UTC

The up-coming ERC project JEUX - Literary Games, Poetics and the Early Modern Novel is advertising a position for a researcher (post-doctoral). The team will play early-modern games with creative writing students and is looking for someone with expertise in interviews, observation and other related methods to accompany that experiment.
